query.text: 请帮我留意人行过街信号，信号允许通行时告诉我，停止通行时提醒我等待。
query.text_en: Please monitor the pedestrian signal, tell me when it permits crossing, and remind me to wait when it stops permitting crossing.

annotation.text_zh: 当前人行信号灯为绿灯，可以通行，请注意安全。
annotation.text_en: The pedestrian signal is currently green and you can cross. Please watch out for your safety.

annotation.text_zh: 现在红灯已亮起，请在路边安全等待。
annotation.text_en: The red light is now on, please wait safely by the roadside.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
